QuestInfo.0: With the parts in hand, the duo returned to #p2411001#. The sweet lullaby maker was almost theirs!
QuestInfo.1: Alpha and Beta got the music box from #p2411001#, along with a strange lecture on dissonant cycles. They hoped against hope that the little box would be able to subdue the great #p2411011#, but they would need to see #b#p2411010##k in #b#MDmap321190300##k before they could be sure.
QuestInfo.2: #p2411011# fell right to sleep when the music box played near it, and #p2411010# told the duo the strange events that had led to its rampage. The giant known as #p2411011# had been a baby mere days before, when it stumbled into a strange relic that looked like a hourglass. Could the relic be responsible?
